His value depends heavily on perimeter efficiency and defensive contributions, making this performance difficult to sustain. Despite starting regularly, his modest usage limits his appeal to deeper fantasy leagues.

news.headline: Okoro ended with 15 points (5-10 FG, 2-6 3Pt, 3-4 FT), three rebounds, two assists, one block and one steal across 41 minutes during Friday's 125-117 overtime victory over the Hawks.
news.story: Okoro made his presence felt Friday and played a season-high 41 minutes, but fantasy managers shouldn't overreact to one performance since Okoro is not expected to become a 15-point-scorer overnight. His ability to contribute occasional steals, blocks and three-pointers makes him a situational option in deeper leagues, though managers should be cautious about expecting this level of playing time or production…

news.headline: Melton notched nine points (3-10 FG, 1-4 3Pt, 2-2 FT), one rebound, five assists, two blocks and two steals over 25 minutes during Thursday's 126-98 loss to the Grizzlies.
news.story: Melton bounced back from Wednesday's scoreless outing, but his shooting struggles persisted. He's converted just 31.6 percent of his attempts over five games, limiting his scoring upside despite Stephen Curry's absence. Melton's defensive versatility remains useful in deeper category leagues.

news.headline: Melton is starting Thursday's game against Memphis.
news.story: Melton will enter the starting five after being deployed off the bench in his previous two showings. LJ Cryer will rotate to the bench as a result. Melton finished with eight points, four rebounds, three assists, one steal and one block across 18 minutes during his last start Friday against San Antonio.

news.headline: Melton is not listed in the starting lineup for Monday's game against New Orleans, Dalton Johnson of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.
news.story: Melton got the start for Friday's 123-85 loss to San Antonio, but two-way guard LJ Cryer, who netted a team-high 20 points and six triples in the loss, will get the starting nod Monday. Melton figures to stay involved as a reserve with Stephen Curry (oblique) still sidelined.

news.story: Horford returned after sitting out Wednesday for injury management, but his offensive struggles continued. He's scored just five points across his last four appearances, shooting 2-for-18 from the field. With Charles Bassey earning additional frontcourt opportunities, Horford's limited minutes and declining offensive involvement make him difficult to roster outside deeper leagues.

news.headline: Horford (back) is available for Thursday's game against the Grizzlies.
news.story: Horford is ready to suit up for the second half of this back-to-back. Draymond Green (elbow) is out, so Horford should soak up more playing time.

news.headline: Horford (back) is out for Wednesday's game against the Mavericks, but he will play Thursday against the Grizzlies, Nick Friedell of The Athletic reports.
news.story: Horford will miss the first half of a back-to-back set Wednesday due to a back injury, but he will be available Thursday. Charles Bassey could see an expanded role in Horford's absence, while Horford could see a larger role than usual Thursday, as Draymond Green is set to rest.
